_about: Site settings. Leave a value empty to turn that feature off. cloudflare_token: the token from Cloudflare Web Analytics (cookieless page counts). google / bing: the meta-tag verification codes, if you ever use that method (the site is verified with a DNS record for Google and src/BingSiteAuth.xml for Bing) from Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools (the 'content' value of their meta tag). contact_email: shown on the privacy page for questions and removal requests. mailing_address: needed in every letter you send, not on the site.
